text.title: Content Audit Process Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to apply the Content Audit Process methodology end-to-end, with step 3 expanded into the six-step audit run (scope, inventory, spreadsheet, evaluation, actions, report).

step.name: check-preconditions
step.input: The "Applies If" + "Skip If" lists from AGENTS.md.
step.action: Verify every Applies-If item holds AND no Skip-If item triggers.
step.output: Boolean: methodology applies / does not apply.
step.decision-gate: If preconditions fail, emit a skip-record naming the failed precondition and STOP.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Read each input; attach its path/URL to the working artefact. Refuse to proceed if any input is unreachable.
step.decision-gate: If any input is unreachable, halt and request the source before proceeding.

step.name: apply-rules
step.input: Inputs gathered + the rules from content/01-core-rules.xml.
step.action: Walk each rule in order; record per-rule pass/fail; capture the violating snippet on any fail.
step.decision-gate: If any HARD rule fails, repair the artefact or escalate; do not return a partially-conformant output.

step.name: produce-artefact
step.input: Rule-conformant inputs + the schema in content/02-output-contract.xml.
step.action: Fill the template under `templates/content-audit-process.json` according to the schema.

step.name: validate-and-handover
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-content-audit-process.py --file <path>`. Fix any reported violations. Send to named owner for sign-off.
step.output: Owner-signed artefact registered with the downstream consumer.
step.decision-gate: If validator returns non-zero, do not hand over — repair and re-validate.

step.name: define-scope-and-goals
step.action: Scope before data (r6-scope-before-data). Questions to answer: What content is in scope (all pages, blog only, help center)? What do we want to learn (what exists, what performs)? How will results be used (migration, strategy, cleanup)? Evaluation criteria to set: accuracy, relevance, quality, performance, accessibility, SEO.

step.name: gather-inventory
step.action: Crawl plus manual supplement (r7-crawler-plus-manual). Automated: site crawler (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb), CMS export, sitemap. Manual additions: PDFs and downloads, gated content, dynamic content, legacy systems.
step.decision-gate: If the crawl and CMS export disagree on counts, reconcile before scoring.

step.name: create-spreadsheet
step.action: Lay out the columns in r8-minimum-columns using templates/audit-spreadsheet.md; tag legal-hold items (r5-legal-hold-honoured).

step.name: evaluate-each-piece
step.action: Score every item on all criteria before any action (r9-score-before-action, r2-multi-criterion-score). Per-item questions: Is it accurate and up-to-date? Relevant to users? Well-written? Performing well in analytics? Accessible? SEO-optimized?

step.name: assign-actions
step.action: Assign exactly one of the six actions per item (r3-six-actions-typed); apply r11 for same-topic clusters and r12 before any Remove.
step.decision-gate: Any Remove on a legal-hold item is a hard fail; any same-topic cluster marked Update is sent back.

step.name: report-and-recommend
step.action: Rank by impact × effort (r4-impact-effort-priority); write the summary with owners and timelines (r10-report-owners-timelines) into templates/audit-report.md.
